objects.text:
A safe home
for your apps

Your AI agent installs apps here.
Open or switch them any time.
Type an app ID from Mosaico Ideas.
Ask your AI agent to build one. It installs over USB.
It's the orange key on the top edge.

To download apps, get updates
and turn on Mosaico AI.

Download an app by its ID,
or develop your own.

apps.name: Pixel Pet
apps.summary: A tiny dot-matrix pet that lives on your screen. Feed it, play with it and watch it grow.

apps.name: Lo-fi Clock
apps.summary: A calm dot-matrix desk clock with alarms and a gentle night mode.

apps.name: Photo Frame
apps.summary: Shows a slideshow of photos you send from your phone over Wi-Fi.

apps.name: Pomodoro
apps.summary: A focus timer with 25-minute sessions, short breaks and a daily streak.

apps.name: Emoji Face
apps.summary: Turns the screen into an expressive face that reacts to sound and touch.

apps.name: Voice Notes
apps.summary: Record short voice memos and play them back any time.

apps.name: Music Box
apps.summary: Plays relaxing tunes and white noise through the built-in speaker.

apps.name: Rhythm Pad
apps.summary: Tap the screen to play drums and loops, then record your beat.

apps.name: Weather Station
apps.summary: Live weather for your city: temperature, rain and a 3-day forecast.

apps.name: Home Remote
apps.summary: Control smart lights and plugs on your home network from one screen.

apps.name: Plant Buddy
apps.summary: Reminds you to water your plants and logs soil moisture from a sensor.

apps.name: Air Monitor
apps.summary: Shows temperature, humidity and air quality from an attached sensor.

apps.name: Light Meter
apps.summary: Measures ambient light with an attached sensor and charts it over the day.

apps.name: Sound Meter
apps.summary: Measures noise with the microphone and warns you when it gets loud.

apps.name: AI Chat
apps.summary: Talk to an AI assistant and read its answers on screen. Uses the shared AI token.

apps.name: Morse Chat
apps.summary: Send and receive Morse code messages with friends over Wi-Fi.

apps.name: Walkie Talkie
apps.summary: Push-to-talk voice messages between Mosaico devices on the same network.

apps.name: Servo Lab
apps.summary: Drive up to four hobby servos with sliders and save your favorite poses.

apps.name: Robot Car
apps.summary: Remote-control a two-motor robot car with on-screen arrows.

apps.name: Fan Control
apps.summary: Speed control for a DC fan, with an automatic mode based on temperature.

store_only.name: Retro Snake
store_only.summary: The classic snake game with dot-matrix graphics and a high-score table.

store_only.name: Dice Roller
store_only.summary: Roll up to six dice with a shake animation. Great for board games.
